instruction: The "~/photographs/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/photographs/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

import os

token = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password='Ia$)7$5')['access_token']
spots = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=token, directory_path='~/photographs/vacations', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)

spot_names = [os.path.basename(p.rstrip('/')) for p in spots]

# ensure output directory exists
out_dir = '~/photographs/vacations'
print('ensure_out_dir')
print(apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=out_dir, access_token=token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True))

results = []
for spot in spot_names:
    src_dir = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}'
    zip_path = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip'
    zip_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=token, file_path=zip_path)
    print('spot', spot, 'zip_exists', zip_exists)
    r = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=src_dir, access_token=token, compressed_file_path=zip_path, delete_directory=False, overwrite=bool(zip_exists))
    results.append((spot, zip_path, r.get('compressed_file_path'), r.get('message', None)))
    print('compress_result', results[-1])

print('compression_done_count', len(results))

import os

token = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password='Ia$)7$5')['access_token']

spots = ['athens','maui','stockholm','tokyo']
print('spots_to_delete', spots)

# Delete them
delete_results = []
for spot in spots:
    src_dir = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}'
    # check before delete
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=token, directory_path=src_dir)
    print('deleting', spot, 'exists_before', exists)
    if exists:
        r = apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=token, directory_path=src_dir)
        delete_results.append((spot, 'deleted', r.get('message', None)))
    else:
        delete_results.append((spot, 'missing', None))

print('delete_results', delete_results)

# Verify deletion
